name: Furtive Investor
subtitle: i never invest without an exit strategy
rules: COVERT -- This card enters play with 2 tokens on it. -- This card loses 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- At the start of your turn, you may pick a non-resource card you control. If you do, remove a token from that card.
notes: No artist credit in footer.

name: Hired Goons
subtitle: goons. hired goons.
rules: COVERT -- At the start of your turn, you may pay 2. If you don't, your opponent takes control of this card.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent'; catalog says 'an opponent' (newer templating). No artist credit in footer.

name: Inside Information
subtitle: damning record of depravity
rules: PROFIT -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Draw 4 cards. Your opponent takes control of this card.
flavor: "It's just a bunch of yowling! What the hell am I paying you for!?"
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent takes control'; catalog 'An opponent takes control' (newer templating). No artist credit in footer.

name: Keen Stratagem
subtitle: if you want money, you'll have to pay for it
rules: Search your deck for a staple resource, reveal it, and put it into your hand.
flavor: "It is well that the people of the nation do not understand our banking and monetary system, for if they did, I believe there would be a revolution before tomorrow morning."
notes: Same effect, sentences restructured in catalog. No artist credit in footer.

name: Key Man
subtitle: congratulations...you're our 23rd CEO!
rules: If this card leaves play, draw a card.
flavor: "Bruno here will uncork the bubbly when you reach altitude."
notes: Card prints 'If this card leaves play'; catalog 'When this card leaves play' (newer trigger templating). No artist credit in footer.

name: Market Oracle
subtitle: signs point to "buy"
rules: INVEST -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a non-resource card you control. -- EFFECT – Remove a token from the card.
flavor: I have a sell order on Empire Impoverishments when the pendulum swings north.
notes: No artist credit in footer.

name: Mau Party
subtitle: it's not a party until somebody gets devoured
rules: COST – Play this only during your turn. -- EFFECT – Draw 5 cards. Your faction gains 2 influence.
flavor: After we run them over, we stop the car and eat them.
notes: Card prints 'Play this only during your turn'; catalog 'Deploy this only during your turn' (newer terminology). No artist credit in footer.

name: Moneychanger
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Patrick Meehan
rules: This card loses 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- EXCHANGE -- COST – Put a token on this card. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.
flavor: Don't forget to wipe your money.
notes: Cost sentences in a different order than catalog (card: put a token, then deplete). No 'Art:' credit in footer; Patrick Meehan is credited in the subtitle. Footer reads ARTIST SERIES; watermark 'Artist Series' over text box.

name: Motivational Speaker
subtitle: awaken the giant within
rules: If this card blocks, all members of the blocking party gain 2 strength and 2 life this turn. (This includes this character.)
flavor: "You too can unleash your inner strength and achieve even your wildest dreams! Now get out there, and foreclose on that orphanage!"
notes: Card prints 'If this card blocks'; catalog 'When this card blocks' (newer trigger templating). No artist credit in footer.

name: Mutiny Grant
subtitle: whatever you make, i'll double it
rules: COST – Pick a character your opponent controls. Your faction loses X influence, where X is the numeric cost of that character. -- EFFECT – This turn, you control the character. Restore the character.
notes: Card: 'COST –' / 'your opponent controls' / 'you control the character'; catalog uses newer templating (EXTRA COST, an opponent, take control). No artist credit in footer.

name: Officious Obstructionist
subtitle: towering maven of bureaucratic rule
rules: STUBBORNNESS -- COST – Pay 1. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains 1 life.
flavor: "I don't care what you're Lord of, the registration closes at 5 PM."
notes: No artist credit in footer.

name: Overinsured Figurehead
subtitle: he used to be so down to earth
rules: If this card leaves play, draw 2 cards.
flavor: That new job title has really gone to his head. I don't like how he's always talking down to us these days.
notes: Card prints 'If this card leaves play'; catalog 'When this card leaves play' (newer trigger templating). No artist credit in footer.

name: Prudent Thug
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Jack Heng
rules: When this card enters play, your faction loses 3 influence. -- This card loses 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- This card can attack only once each turn. -- RESTORE -- COST – Pay 1. Put a token on this card. -- EFFECT – Restore this card.
notes: No 'Art:' credit in footer; Jack Heng is credited in the subtitle. Footer reads ARTIST SERIES; watermark 'Artist Series' over text box.

name: Pugnacious Publicist
subtitle: time to issue a "full contact" press release
rules: When this card enters play, all your characters gain 1 life this turn.
flavor: "Here's one for your editor, too!"
notes: No artist credit in footer.

name: Randolph von Macovawitz Spitoon III, Ltd.
rules: UNIQUE RANDOLPH -- When this card enters play, draw a card. -- PAYDAY LOAN -- COST – Pay 1. Discard a resource or destroy a resource you control. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.
flavor: Randolph has acquired the rarified status of "limited liability person," which means he cannot be held responsible for his actions as long as he's acting in his own best interest.
notes: No subtitle line. No artist credit in footer.

name: Real Estate Auctioneer
subtitle: every home has its flaws
rules: LIQUIDATE -- COST – Pay 2. Discard a card. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Draw 2 cards.
flavor: "Do I hear 20,000? 20,000 for this lovely home with only a slight human infestation?"
notes: No artist credit in footer.

name: Reluctant Hiree
subtitle: i dunno...it's shiny and all, but...
rules: This card enters play with 3 tokens on it. -- This card loses 1 strength for each token on it. -- INVEST -- COST – Pay X, where X is the number of tokens on this card. -- EFFECT – Remove a token from this card.
notes: No artist credit in footer.

name: Revivatate
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Jack Heng
rules: COST – Play this only during your turn. Pick 2 characters in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put 1 of the characters into play under your control and 1 into your hand.
flavor: If you didn't have Jack Heng, you'd have to invent him.
notes: Card prints 'Play this only'; catalog 'Deploy this only' (newer terminology); second sentence restructured but same effect. No 'Art:' credit in footer; Jack Heng is credited in the subtitle. Footer reads ARTIST SERIES; watermark 'Artist Series' over text box.

name: Short Term Investment
subtitle: life insurance? won't need that where i'm going!
rules: This card comes into play with 2 tokens on it. -- At the start of your turn, remove a token from this card. -- RETURN -- COST – Use this only if there are no tokens on this card. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Draw 3 cards.
flavor: The wife can eat cat food.
notes: Card prints 'Destroy this card'; catalog 'Destroy it' (same meaning). No artist credit in footer.

name: Smear Campaign
subtitle: eat them? no, I was...kissing them...with a fork.
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- If the attached character inflicts any amount of damage, inflict an equal amount of damage to the character's controller's faction.
flavor: Despite his moderate populist stance on foreign policy and the sarcophyle problem, Senator Tysonburg's penchant for babymeat proved too much for voters to stomach.
notes: Card: 'If the attached character inflicts any amount of damage, inflict an equal amount'; catalog: 'When ... inflicts damage, inflict the same amount' (newer templating, same effect). No artist credit in footer.

name: Snooty Doorman
subtitle: oh, i'm sorry sir
rules: DENIED! -- COST – Use this only in response to a character being played. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – When the character is finished being played, put it into its owner's discard pile instead of into play.
flavor: "...you're just not our kind of people."
notes: Card spells out the effect (put the character into its owner's discard pile instead of into play, 'being played'); catalog uses the defined term 'Terminate the character' and 'being deployed' (CR terminate sends a terminated card to its owner's discard). Same play. No artist credit in footer.

name: Subsection 5, Paragraph 12
subtitle: that's the one with the monster in it
rules: Your opponent cannot respond to this card. -- COST – Play this only in response to an ability that's source was not a faction. -- EFFECT – The ability has no effect and cannot be used again this turn. Draw a card.
notes: Card: 'Your opponent cannot respond' as a separate line, 'Play this only', 'The ability has no effect'; catalog folds these into EXTRA COST and uses 'Deploy' / 'Terminate the ability' (newer templating). Card prints 'that's source' (sic), catalog repeats it. No artist credit in footer.

name: Tad Disingenuous
subtitle: hey, judge-baby, you look ravishing! rrrrowr!
rules: UNDERHANDED DEAL -- COST – Discard a card. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains COVERT.
flavor: "I don't use the word 'hero' very often, but you sir...are the greatest hero in Mau history."
notes: No artist credit in footer.

name: The Garbageman
subtitle: well, looky here! come to papa, baby!
rules: This card can attack only once each turn. -- SIFT -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Draw a card. Discard a card. -- RUMMAGE -- COST – Pay 2. Remove 3 cards in your discard pile from the game. -- EFFECT – Restore this card.
flavor: "...shake the plastic bag and do the twisty thing they do...the garbageman! Ohhh, the garbageman can!"
notes: No artist credit in footer.

name: Writ of Reclamation
subtitle: i don't care where you took it, it's still mine!
rules: COST – Pick a number for X that is 3 or less. Remove X cards in your discard pile from the game. Pick X other cards in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Shuffle the other cards into your deck. Draw a card.
flavor: "...and said thieves shall return the property to its original foundation, at their own expense."
notes: Card prints 'Pick a number for X'; catalog 'Choose a number for X' (newer templating). No artist credit in footer.

name: 0p3r4710n 1337 H4x0rz
subtitle: been outside lately?
rules: COST – Play this only during your turn. -- EFFECT – You may play up to 4 non-tactic cards for free. (You still need the proper resource icons and must pay any additional costs.)
flavor: "No. Now go away...we are playing for the title of Ch4mp10n 0f teh Un1v3r53."
notes: Card: 'Play this only', 'play up to 4', reminder '(You still need the proper resource icons and must pay any additional costs.)'; catalog uses Deploy and 'meet its threshold and satisfy its extra costs' (newer templating, same meaning). No artist credit in footer.

name: 4p7 31f
subtitle: 1337 700L h4ndL1ng sk1llz
rules: If a "gear" card becomes attached to this card, you may detach a resource from your faction. -- While a "gear" card is attached to this card, this card gains 1 strength and 1 life.
flavor: Also nunchuck sk1llz, b0whun71ng sk1llz, c0mpu73r h4ck1ng sk1llz
notes: Trigger differs: card triggers whenever a gear card BECOMES ATTACHED to this card (includes handoff/other attach effects); catalog says 'When you DEPLOY a gear card attached to this card', which narrows it to deploying. Catalog's second line says 'it gains' (ambiguous) vs printed 'this card gains'. No artist credit in footer.

name: Acuminous Gigantitect
subtitle: ants! you all look like little, tiny ANTS!
rules: GRAND DESIGN -- COST – Pay 2. Discard a card. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – The next numeric cost you pay this turn is reduced by 6.
flavor: "hahahahaha! Smush you!"
notes: Same effect, sentence voice differs ('is reduced by 6' vs 'Reduce ... by 6'). No artist credit in footer.

name: Contriving Engineer
subtitle: now raise your left hand
rules: When this card enters play, you may search your deck for a card named "Elitism" and put it into play attached to your faction.
flavor: "Now pull the other 31f's trunks off. Yes, just like that. Good."
notes: Catalog adds 'and reveal it. If you do, put it into play. Attach it to your faction.' Printed card has no reveal step and no 'If you do' (search, put into play attached to your faction). Catalog likely reflects the later Ungodly Mess wording. No artist credit in footer.

name: Discommodiousness
subtitle: limited edition artwork by FangWei
rules: Your opponent must reveal their hand and shuffle all tactics from it into their deck. Your opponent draws X cards, where X is the number of tactics shuffled into their deck. Draw a card.
notes: Card: 'Your opponent must reveal their hand and shuffle all tactics from it into their deck. Your opponent draws X'; catalog: 'An opponent reveals... That player draws X' (newer templating, same effect). No 'Art:' credit in footer; FangWei is credited in the subtitle. Footer reads ARTIST SERIES; watermark 'Artist Series' over text box.

name: Elite Team Registration
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Teckchin
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 Gearsmith characters with different names, reveal them, and put them into your hand.
flavor: There is no theory of evolution. Only a list of creatures Teckchin allows to live.
notes: Catalog splits into 'reveal them. Put them into your hand.' (same effect). No 'Art:' credit in footer; Teckchin is credited in the subtitle. Footer reads ARTIST SERIES; watermark 'Artist Series' over text box.

name: Epiphany Ball
subtitle: the answer just hit me! (hold for laughter)
rules: SUDDEN INSIGHT -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Your opponent takes control of this card.
flavor:
Thanks folks...I'll be here all night!
<applause>
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent takes control'; catalog 'An opponent takes control' (newer templating). No artist credit in footer.

name: Exploding Sock Puppet!
subtitle: taxi apple sponge!
rules: Your opponent cannot respond to this card. -- COST – Play this only in response to a character's ability. -- EFFECT – The ability has no effect. Destroy the character.
flavor: Skunks playing poker, basketball cheesesteak!
notes: Card: 'The ability has no effect', 'Play this only'; catalog folds 'cannot respond' into EXTRA COST and uses 'Deploy' / 'Terminate the ability' (newer templating). No artist credit in footer.

name: Guardforce Alpha Prime 31f
subtitle: i select you!
rules: This card can attack even if it has not been in play under your control since the start of the turn.
flavor: "You are my monster selection!"
notes: No artist credit in footer.

name: Guardforce Alpha Prime H4x0r
subtitle: 1 4r3 73h r007
rules: UNIQUE GUARDFORCE ALPHA PRIME H4X0R -- This card can attack even if it has not been in play under your control since the start of the turn. -- If this card inflicts damage to a faction, you may play a resource.
notes: Card prints 'If this card inflicts damage to a faction'; catalog 'When this card inflicts damage...' (newer trigger templating). No artist credit in footer.

name: Guardforce Morphmajig
subtitle: it looks angry! what's it saying?
rules: This card can attack even if it has not been in play under your control since the start of the turn. -- If you play a card, put a token on this card. (Playing a resource doesn't count.) -- If your opponent plays a card, remove a token from this card. -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it.
notes: Catalog adds a second reminder '(Playing a resource doesn't count.)' to the opponent line; the card prints that reminder only after the 'If you play a card' line, and the opponent line has none. Could change whether an opponent playing a resource removes a token. Leetspeak flavor transcribed from zoomed crop; 'W0u1|)' (the '|)' is for 'd') is the least certain glyph group. No artist credit in footer.

name: Heavy Plating
subtitle: oh boy...sleep! that's where i'm a viking!
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- When this card enters play, you may detach up to 2 resources from your faction. -- The attached character gains 4 strength, 4 life, and loses 1 speed. -- HANDOFF -- COST – Pay 5. Deplete a character you control that is not in a battle. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.
notes: Item modifier badges: +4 STR, -1 SPD, +4 LIFE. No artist credit in footer.

name: Horsemajig of the Apocalypse - Death
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Sonny Liew
rules: All other "horsemajig" characters gain 1 strength, 1 life, and 1 speed.
flavor: just find the strength, among them all, that's higher than its friends. you put them all, beside themselves, and you'll have passed the test! then each majig, beyond the first, you'll need to add once more. then you should be, proud of yourself, your mind you had to flex!
notes: No 'Art:' credit in footer; Sonny Liew is credited in the subtitle. Footer reads ARTIST SERIES; watermark 'Artist Series' over text box. Speech bubble 'TOBOR KILL!' is part of the artwork.

name: Horsemajig of the Apocalypse - Famine
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Henry Gunawan
rules: All other "horsemajig" characters gain 1 speed.
flavor: When all you have, is one of each, you'll see the way they blend, And when you find, the numbers that, were greater than the rest, At first you need, to do the steps, I talked about before, Now if you solved, the mystery, behind this flavor text,
notes: No 'Art:' credit in footer; Henry Gunawan is credited in the subtitle. Footer reads ARTIST SERIES; watermark 'Artist Series' over text box. Flavor poem ends mid-sentence on this card ('behind this flavor text,'), continues on other horsemajig cards.

name: Horsemajig of the Apocalypse - Pestilence
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Ivan Ng
rules: All other "horsemajig" characters gain 1 life.
flavor: to find their stats, can seem quite hard, 'tis easy as can be! for then you'll know, once and for all, the horsemajig's true size. there's one of each, no more no less, so follow me again! then add the rest, you'll have their stats, decipherment galore!
notes: No 'Art:' credit in footer; Ivan Ng is credited in the subtitle. Footer reads ARTIST SERIES; watermark 'Artist Series' over text box.

name: Horsemajig of the Apocalypse - War
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Chris de Joya, Teckchin
rules: All other "horsemajig" characters gain 1 strength.
flavor: The horsemajigs, they thrive in groups, as you will come to see, Then do the same, for life and speed, to try this out is wise, But wait there's more, you are not done, this only works out when, So if you have, them side by side, they'll start as two three four,
notes: No 'Art:' credit in footer; Chris de Joya and Teckchin are credited in the subtitle. Footer reads ARTIST SERIES; watermark 'Artist Series' over text box. Flavor poem ends mid-sentence on this card ('they'll start as two three four,').

name: Kaiser Wave
subtitle: behold the kaiser ultimate attack!
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 1 strength and 1 life. It gains an additional 1 strength and 1 life for each "kaiser" card in play. It gains an additional 1 strength and 1 life if it is a "kaiser" character.
notes: Catalog labels the cost 'EXTRA COST:' (newer templating). No artist credit in footer.
